data.name: Staybridge Suites Monterrey - San Pedro by IHG
data.address: Calzada San Pedro : 103, Col. del Valle, 66220 Monterrey, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
On a tree-lined, 2-way street, this informal all-suite hotel is 1 km from shopping in Calzada del Valle, 8 km from the Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Monterrey and 14 km from Parque Fundidora.
Straightforward suites with wood furnishings feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and DVD players, as well as living areas and kitchens. Some have pool views.
Complimentary perks include parking and hot breakfast, as well as drinks and snacks on limited weeknights. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, BBQ grills and a fitness room, plus a lounge, guest laundry facilities and a business center.
